title: Shadows over Innistrad: card flavor text

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A gothic plane whose fate is uncertain as Avacyn goes mad.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel, once guardian of Innistrad, whose madness turns her wings bloody; created by Sorin.

entities.name: Grete
entities.description: A cathar apostate who rejects Avacyn as guardian.

entities.name: Lunarch Council
entities.description: The church council, infiltrated by the Skirsdag and corrupt.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who created Avacyn, pursued by Nahiri.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who destroyed Markov Manor and vows to take everything from Sorin.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Sorin's ancestral home, destroyed by Nahiri.

entities.name: Saint Traft
entities.description: Namesake of the Order of Saint Traft.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who speaks of the pure standing tall.

entities.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
entities.description: A cathar who founded the Order of Saint Traft against the Lunarch Council's corruption.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: Cathars founded by Thalia to stand against corruption.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A moonfolk scholar whose journal records cryptoliths and Avacyn's madness.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker investigating cryptoliths who was sent to find Sorin.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: A necro-alchemist who writes to Geralf proposing collaboration.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire progenitor of the Stromkirk bloodline who worships the deep.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who summoned her bloodline to Lurenbraum Fortress at Sorin's appeal.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker necromancer on Innistrad who rebuffs Jace's accusations.

entities.name: Halmig
entities.description: Member of the Order of Saint Traft.

entities.name: Halana
entities.description: A Kessig ranger who grew brambles.

entities.name: Rupirk
entities.description: Porter at the Rusted Anchor Inn.

entities.name: Ormendahl, Profane Prince
entities.description: A demon who took Griselbrand's place with the Skirsdag.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon formerly worshipped by the Skirsdag, now gone.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A demon cult that has infiltrated the Lunarch Council.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: A period ended by the renewed howling of werewolves, the beginning of Avacyn's madness.

entities.name: Drownyard Temple
entities.description: A temple to which all cryptoliths point.

entities.name: Cryptoliths
entities.description: Warped stones twisting the plane's mana.

entities.name: Hollowhenge
entities.description: Ruins of Avabruck, being restored as capital of Kessig.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: Coastal region shrouded in the Nebelgast.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane that bled, which Nahiri compares to Innistrad's fate.

events.summary: Nahiri visits Markov Manor, sending a message to Sorin.
events.quote: The message was clear to Sorin—Nahiri had paid Markov Manor a visit.

events.summary: Nahiri vows to take everything from Sorin.
events.quote: Sorin, I'm going to take everything from you.

events.summary: Nahiri compares Zendikar's bleeding to what Innistrad and Sorin will suffer.
events.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad. As I have wept, so will Sorin.

events.summary: Nahiri twists stone gargoyles to her will.
events.quote: Nahiri twisted them in shape and bent them to her will.

events.summary: Sorin must end Avacyn, whom he created.
events.quote: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

events.summary: The howling of werewolves marks the end of the Cursemute and the start of Avacyn's madness.
events.quote: The renewed howling of werewolves announced the end of the Cursemute—and the beginning of Avacyn's madness.

events.summary: Thalia founds the Order of Saint Traft against the Lunarch Council's corruption.
events.quote: Thalia established the Order of Saint Traft in an effort to bring together cathars who would stand against the corruption of the Lunarch Council.

events.summary: Cathars of the Order of Saint Traft turn on each other.
events.quote: Cathars who had fought shoulder to shoulder were at each other's throats.

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren summons her bloodline to Lurenbraum Fortress at Sorin's appeal.
events.quote: At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summoned the full might of her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.

events.summary: Jace is sent to find Sorin and reaches Markov Manor, finding a deeper mystery.
events.quote: Sent to find Sorin, Jace ventured to the vampire's ancestral home, only to find evidence of a deeper mystery.

events.summary: Jace discovers that all cryptoliths point to Drownyard Temple.
events.quote: This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!

events.summary: Jace asks Tamiyo whether this is what she found.
events.quote: Is this what you found, Tamiyo?

events.summary: Jace confronts Liliana with accusations after she was asked for help.
events.quote: Days ago, you came to my door asking for help, Jace. Yet now here you are with accusations?

events.summary: Liliana is angered by Nahiri's provocation.
events.quote: You sought to anger me, Nahiri. Soon you will see how well you have succeeded.

events.summary: Ormendahl quickly takes Griselbrand's place for the Skirsdag.
events.quote: Ormendahl did not make them wait long.

events.summary: The Skirsdag infiltrate the Lunarch Council.
events.quote: Having infiltrated the Lunarch Council, the Skirsdag await the perfect moment to strike.

events.summary: Ludevic proposes collaboration to Geralf.
events.quote: At your convenience, I would be honored to collaborate on a project.

events.summary: Gisa mocks her brother Geralf for sharing his toys with Ludevic.
events.quote: Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates.

events.summary: The destruction of Markov Manor makes the surviving Markovs more dangerous.
events.quote: The destruction of Markov Manor made the surviving members of the bloodline more dangerous.

events.summary: Survivors restore the ruins of Avabruck as Kessig's capital.
events.quote: Some have returned to Hollowhenge, the ruins of Avabruck, to restore the lost capital of Kessig.
